groups.problem: Migration inserts legacy embeddable_hosts values verbatim (with scheme/path), so they never match record_for_host lookups.
groups.rationale: Both point at the same INSERT and describe the same missing normalization of scheme/path before insert.

groups.problem: Migration dereferences execute(...)[0]['id'] without checking for an empty result, crashing before the category_id==0 fallback.
groups.rationale: Same lines, same nil-row dereference in the embed_category lookup.

groups.problem: EmbeddingSerializer uses embed: :ids without sideloading the embeddable_hosts records, so the client cannot hydrate them.
groups.rationale: Both flag the same has_many line missing include: true / object embedding.

groups.problem: EmbeddableHostsController update/destroy use the looked-up host without a nil check, raising NoMethodError for missing ids.
groups.rationale: Both report the missing nil guard after where(id:).first in the controller actions.

groups.problem: before_validation calls host.sub! on a possibly nil host, raising NoMethodError instead of producing a validation error.
groups.rationale: Identical issue at the same lines in embeddable_host.rb.

groups.problem: The spec 'is false if embeddable_host is blank' no longer tests what its name says, since embeddable hosts aren't checked anymore.
groups.rationale: Both point out the same misleading test name/setup in topic_spec.rb.
